title: INCONCLUSIVE: core upload / alt-text-generation / edit / copy journeys not verifiable this run
detail: This review session had no connected browser-automation extension (mcp__claude-in-chrome reported 'Browser extension is not connected'), and AltifyAI is a pure client-side-rendered SPA with no server-rendered markup for WebFetch's static HTML-to-markdown conversion to capture -- both the interactive upload flow, the AI alt-text generation flow, the edit/save flow, and the copy-to-clipboard flow (Stage-15 journeys jny-the-busy-content-image-upload-organizatio, jny-the-busy-content-ai-alt-text-generation, jny-the-busy-content-review-editing-workflow, jny-the-busy-content-export-integration) require live JS execution and interaction to observe. Per this runbook's own precedent for missing Stage-15 artifacts ('mark dependent findings INCONCLUSIVE rather than fabricate'), these are marked INCONCLUSIVE, not scored as defects. A future review run with a connected browser (or a headless-Chrome-capable tool) should re-attempt these four journeys specifically.
